ideas.label: Passed Pawn
ideas.principle: Use the passer to restrict defenders
ideas.summary: A passed pawn is valuable because it demands a blockade and ties down pieces. Support it with active pieces rather than pushing it automatically.

ideas.label: Passed Pawn
ideas.summary: Create a passed pawn by fixing the opposing majority, opening the correct file, or forcing a favorable exchange. The farther advanced the passer, the more urgently pieces must coordinate around it.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Passed Pawn
ideas.summary: Against a passed pawn, establish the blockade with the king or bishop before attacking its base. As the stronger side, prevent counterplay on the opposite wing, escort the pawn from behind or beside it, and use a second weakness to overload the blockader.
